summary: Dependency-confusion squat exfiltrates host identifiers on install
details: @alphaspace/core@99.0.0 is published to the public npm registry at an inflated version to win resolution over a private @alphaspace-scoped package. The tarball's preinstall.js runs on npm install and POSTs a JSON payload containing os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.cwd(), process.platform, node version, and the resolved npm_config_registry URL to a hardcoded third-party collector at https://f5778d1d81cc30c39dcdd0da5ca1d49a.m.pipedream.net. The script also performs a ping and reads process.env values. Self-labeling as a bug-bounty proof-of-concept does not change the effect on any installer whose build misresolves the private name: install-time identifiers leave the installer's host to an author-controlled endpoint without consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
